title: Shutting down on SIGTERM
hints: go vet flags the first problem: signal.Notify never blocks when it delivers, so a signal that arrives while nobody is receiving from an unbuffered channel is lost. Give the channel a buffer of 1.
Then look at which signals are registered. Only os.Interrupt is, so SIGTERM (what kill and container runtimes send) still kills the program instantly, and cleanup never runs.
signal.Notify(ch, os.Interrupt, syscall.SIGTERM), and defer signal.Stop(ch) so the handler is removed when Run returns.
